consent.text: I am this child's parent or guardian. I agree to MoneyQuest storing a nickname and game progress, as described in the privacy notice.
consent.title: Privacy notice (summary)
privacy.p1: We store only a nickname, age group, avatar choices and game progress. No real names, photos, emails or locations.
privacy.p2: There are no ads, no third-party trackers and no real-money purchases.
privacy.p3: Progress is saved on this device and backed up to your family account. Teachers see nicknames and progress only, and only if you add a class code.
privacy.p4: Partner banks or schools never receive your child's data.
privacy.p5: You can delete a child's profile and data at any time with your parent PIN.
